meta.title: Unit Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert between length, weight, and temperature units instantly. Supports metric and imperial. Runs entirely in your browser.
steps_unit-converter_1Desc: Choose your measurement type: length, weight, or temperature. Switch between categories using the tab buttons at the top.
steps_unit-converter_2Desc: Type your number and select the source unit from the dropdown. The complete conversion table updates in real time showing all units simultaneously.
steps_unit-converter_3Desc: All unit conversions display at once in a clean table. Click any result to copy it. Perfect for engineering, cooking, travel, and science.
